newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin's public relations chief quits.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin's public relations chief quits.

text.p: Mikhail Lesin, a key member of last year's presidential election campaign team, has resigned as head of Boris Yeltsin's public relations department, the Kremlin said on Thursday.
A spokesman at the presidential press service said Lesin, 38, planned to return to work in television and denied his departure was prompted by any disagreements in the Kremlin.
Lesin handled Yeltsin's television and radio campaign during the president's successful re-election bid last year and had been head of the Kremlin public relations department since September.
Itar-Tass news agency said Lesin would, among other things, work on a popular television chat show.
